{{Top|leg}}
'''Temlet Dodann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jurisconsult]] and a [[Judicial/Legends|Republic Judiciary]] member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the course of his tenure, Dodann broke the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] ring controlled by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] and the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]]. His discovery of Tikkes' actions forced the senator to flee [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].
